verdict.rationale: Ardent is a hosted Postgres branching and cloning service, so asking about read replicas and HA/failover is a fair question for this kind of database platform. Nothing in the evidence documents adding read replicas or any high-availability or failover behavior. The 'replication status' metadata and the autoscaling and scale-to-zero claims describe source sync and compute elasticity, not replicas or failover. The community comment about read replicas offers them as an alternative to Ardent, not as an Ardent feature.
